strokeColor.description: Dot ring or polygon border color.
strokeColor.markdownDescription:
Dot ring or polygon border color.

Default: `"#ffffff"`

strokeWidth.description: Dot ring or polygon border width. 0 = none.
strokeWidth.markdownDescription:
Dot ring or polygon border width. 0 = none.

Default: 1 for points, 0 for polygons

opacity.description: Opacity of `color` (polygon fill, dot fill, the line itself), 0 to 1.
opacity.markdownDescription:
Opacity of `color` (polygon fill, dot fill, the line itself), 0 to 1.

Default: `1`

strokeOpacity.description: Opacity of `strokeColor` (dot ring, polygon border), 0 to 1. Lines have no stroke.
strokeOpacity.markdownDescription:
Opacity of `strokeColor` (dot ring, polygon border), 0 to 1. Lines have no stroke.

Default: `1`

oneOf.description: One color plus a few paint options. Meaning depends on geometry: point = dot and ring, line = line, polygon = fill and border.
oneOf.markdownDescription:
One color plus a few paint options. Meaning depends on geometry: point = dot and ring, line = line, polygon = fill and border.
